description: Close Token Accounts. Calls only POST /v4/wallets/util/close-token-accounts and returns an unsigned transaction for the user to sign. This tool does not sign, submit, or broadcast, and it does not accept a private key. Solana API endpoint for closing empty Solana token accounts. Build a transaction to close Token-2022 and SPL token accounts to recover locked SOL.

body.description: Request payload model for close token accounts param parameters used by this API endpoint.

accountAddresses.description: Specific token account addresses to close (auto-fetches if not provided)

gasless.description: Use Vybe fee payer for gas

ownerAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

rentFee.description: Fee percentage on recovered rent (0-1, e.g., 0.20 for 20%)

name: build-close-token-accounts
title: Close Token Accounts
